# Salgsstart Valseverket

I hjertet av Nydalen kommer Valseverket – et nytt boligprosjekt med 152 leiligheter i varige
kvaliteter. Her legges det til rette for et levende bymiljø, med grønne takhager, gode uteområder og
aktive byrom på bakkeplan.

Du bor tett på byliv, kollektivtilbud, butikker og servering, med Akerselva i umiddelbar nærhet.
Leilighetene varierer i størrelse og er tilpasset ulike livsfaser, med fokus på gode planløsninger
og hverdagskvaliteter. Salget av leilighetene er nå i gang.

[Les mer om Valseverket her][18]

[][19]

## [Kystbyen Slemmestad][20]

I Kystbyen Slemmestad vokser det snart frem et levende nabolag og bysentrum. Her blir det 1300
boliger og et rikt kultur- og servicetilbud. Her vil du ha alt du trenger for å bo, leve, dele og
oppleve – med nærhet til sjø, natur, og alt som trengs for å leve et komfortabelt og aktivt liv!
[Les mer om Slemmestad her.][21]

 

## [«*Det beste for byen er også det beste for oss*»][22]

Hvorfor Elkjøp, ice og noen av de største selskapene i Norge er kunder hos Avantor? [Få svaret fra
noen av våre fornøyde kunder her][23].

## Miljøprosjektet Nydalen
## – fra nedlagt industri til yrende liv

Historien om Nydalen er like mangslungen som elven den ligger ved. Den forteller om et område preget
av skog, senere tungindustri, så tomme fabrikkhaller og som nå yrer av liv igjen.

Siden tidlig på 90-tallet har Avantor vært den største bydelsutvikleren i Nydalen. For å skape en
grønn og moderne bydel, satte vi miljøstrategi øverst på agendaen. [Les mer om det vi har gjort for
Nydalen her][24].

# [Vi gjør alt][25]
# [for byens beste][26]

Det betyr også å gjøre det beste for våre kunder og alle deres ansatte. Vi er en av landets mest
erfarne eiendomsforvaltere og håndterer i dag mer enn 330.000 kvadratmeter eiendom. [Les mer om
drift og forvaltning her][27].

[][28]
[][29]
[][30]

Et bygg som kan ta pusten fra de fleste og arbeidsdagen til et helt nytt nivå!

[Les mer her][32]

## [«*Det beste for byen er også det beste for oss*»][22]

Hvorfor Elkjøp, ice og noen av de største selskapene i Norge er kunder hos Avantor? [Få svaret fra
noen av våre fornøyde kunder her][23].

## Miljøprosjektet Nydalen
## – fra nedlagt industri til yrende liv

Historien om Nydalen er like mangslungen som elven den ligger ved. Den forteller om et område preget
av skog, senere tungindustri, så tomme fabrikkhaller og som nå yrer av liv igjen.

Siden tidlig på 90-tallet har Avantor vært den største bydelsutvikleren i Nydalen. For å skape en
grønn og moderne bydel, satte vi miljøstrategi øverst på agendaen. [Les mer om det vi har gjort for
Nydalen her][24].

# [Vi gjør alt][25]
# [for byens beste][26]

Det betyr også å gjøre det beste for våre kunder og alle deres ansatte. Vi er en av landets mest
erfarne eiendomsforvaltere og håndterer i dag mer enn 330.000 kvadratmeter eiendom. [Les mer om
drift og forvaltning her][27].

## Experience.
## Our Chemistry.

[Hero2 2x]
[Red wine bubbles]

With science at the heart of our business, our aim is for our chemistry to deliver better results —
for our customers, for our partners, and for our community — through the consistency of our products
and the quality of our service.

[Home about 2x]

For over 30 years, ChemSupply Australia has provided our customers with the chemicals, reagents and
ingredients they need to succeed.

Our business units — CSA Scientific, CSA Pathology and CSA Ingredients — are specialists in their
own markets, which means that all our customers benefit from our expertise.

With quality-assured Australian manufacturing, logistics, and administration facilities, and
a commitment to compliance and safety standards, ChemSupply Australia will deliver you better
results.

****ChemSupply Australia — experience our chemistry for yourself.****

[Find out more][25]

## Our Business Units

[Shampoo 2x]
[Pipette green 2x]
[Glowing flask 2x]

Our customers benefit from our passion and expertise in chemicals, and our aim to help them create
a better scientific future.

[Find out more][26] [Visit shop][27]

Manufacturers work hard to ensure that their products are of the highest quality. That’s why our
customers rely on us as a key ingredient in their production processes.

[Find out more][28]

Leading pathology laboratories trust our brands — Australian Biostain, Kinetik and Amber Scientific
— to supply diagnostic stains, buffers, reagents and fixatives that deliver accurate results
every time.

[Find out more][29]

### What Drives Us

ChemSupply Australia is driven by our formula for success — Our Vision + Our Mission + Our Values +
Our Pride in Science. This formula enables us to make a positive impact — for our clients, their
customers, our partners and our community.

## Our Chemistry.

for our customers, for our partners, and for our community — through the consistency of our products
and the quality of our service.

[Home about 2x]

For over 30 years, ChemSupply Australia has provided our customers with the chemicals, reagents and
ingredients they need to succeed.

Our business units — CSA Scientific, CSA Pathology and CSA Ingredients — are specialists in their
own markets, which means that all our customers benefit from our expertise.

With quality-assured Australian manufacturing, logistics, and administration facilities, and
a commitment to compliance and safety standards, ChemSupply Australia will deliver you better
results.

****ChemSupply Australia — experience our chemistry for yourself.****

[Shampoo 2x]

# Welcome to Hawkins, Your Source for Quality
# Ingredients, Chemicals, Equipment & Service

Hawkins, Inc. was founded in 1938 and is a leading water treatment and specialty ingredients company
that formulates, manufactures, distributes and blends products for its Water Treatment, Food &
Health Sciences and Industrial Solutions customers. We create value for our customers through superb
service and support, quality products, and personalized applications. Hawkins can customize chemical
and ingredient products with our toll blending capabilities. We’re a domestic company that can
quickly respond to your needs.

## Hawkins Offers An Extensive Line Of Chemicals And Ingredients
## For A Wide Range Of Industries.

## Our Groups:

[[Water treatment chemistry, equipment, full-service partner]][37]
[[Food and health sciences specialty ingredients supplier]][38]
[[Industrial solutions, bulk delivery, custom toll blending]][39]

### [About Hawkins][40]

[Customer-First-Commitment-picture of service rep]

**Customer-First Commitment**

Our long-term success has been the result of a relentless drive to deliver for our customers, 365
days of the year. While we serve diverse industries in different business units, our commitment to
putting our customers first is unfailing. From the moment we make contact with a customer or
potential customer, we work to provide the best service possible.

[guy doing toll-blending picture]

**Customized Products**

Hawkins has chemicals available in a large variety of concentrations. We can provide the chemical
concentrations you’re looking for. Multiple packaging options and custom toll blending services are
also available.

[Click To Find Out More About Custom Toll Blending][41]

[truck picture -show delivery network]

**Delivery Network**

From the moment we make contact with a customer or potential customer, we work to provide the best
service possible–whether it’s arranging for a holiday delivery, making arrangements for unusual
products, or simply just delivering on time, every time. The proof? Many of our customers have been
with Hawkins for more than 20 years.

[Hawkins financial performance data screenshot resized for web display]

**Sustainability**

We are committed to being a responsible, sustainable supplier. See how we incorporate this mindset
into our business operations.

[Find Out More About Our Commitment To Sustainability][42]

[Our Mission & Promise picture of delivery truck]

**Our Mission & Promise**

Mission: To supply quality products and innovative solutions with exceptional service.

Customer Promise: We will respond quickly to changing customer needs with a focus on safety,
technical expertise, and responsible care of the environment and of our community.

[Find out more about Hawkins through our company videos][43]

[Hawkins-Locations Map-2025]

**Locations**

Having fast access to the equipment, support and the service you need for your operation is
important. That’s why Hawkins has been expanding. Check back often to see if we’ve opened a location
near you!

[Find Locations Near You][44]

***Hawkins Has Been Serving Customers For Over 85 Years.  ***

***We Have A Dedicated Team Ready To Help You With All Your Chemical, Ingredient, And Service
Needs.***

**Our Address**

2381 Rosegate
Roseville MN, 55113

[Hawkins Inc.]

# Welcome to Hawkins, Your Source for Quality
# Ingredients, Chemicals, Equipment & Service

Hawkins, Inc. was founded in 1938 and is a leading water treatment and specialty ingredients company
that formulates, manufactures, distributes and blends products for its Water Treatment, Food &
Health Sciences and Industrial Solutions customers. We create value for our customers through superb
service and support, quality products, and personalized applications. Hawkins can customize chemical
and ingredient products with our toll blending capabilities. We’re a domestic company that can
quickly respond to your needs.

## Hawkins Offers An Extensive Line Of Chemicals And Ingredients
## For A Wide Range Of Industries.

## Our Groups:

[[Water treatment chemistry, equipment, full-service partner]][37]
[[Food and health sciences specialty ingredients supplier]][38]
[[Industrial solutions, bulk delivery, custom toll blending]][39]

### [About Hawkins][40]

[Customer-First-Commitment-picture of service rep]

**Customer-First Commitment**

Our long-term success has been the result of a relentless drive to deliver for our customers, 365
days of the year. While we serve diverse industries in different business units, our commitment to
putting our customers first is unfailing. From the moment we make contact with a customer or
potential customer, we work to provide the best service possible.

[guy doing toll-blending picture]

**Customized Products**

Hawkins has chemicals available in a large variety of concentrations. We can provide the chemical
concentrations you’re looking for. Multiple packaging options and custom toll blending services are
also available.

[Click To Find Out More About Custom Toll Blending][41]

[truck picture -show delivery network]

**Delivery Network**

From the moment we make contact with a customer or potential customer, we work to provide the best
service possible–whether it’s arranging for a holiday delivery, making arrangements for unusual
products, or simply just delivering on time, every time. The proof? Many of our customers have been
with Hawkins for more than 20 years.

[Hawkins financial performance data screenshot resized for web display]

**Sustainability**

We are committed to being a responsible, sustainable supplier. See how we incorporate this mindset
into our business operations.

[Find Out More About Our Commitment To Sustainability][42]

[Our Mission & Promise picture of delivery truck]

**Our Mission & Promise**

Mission: To supply quality products and innovative solutions with exceptional service.

Customer Promise: We will respond quickly to changing customer needs with a focus on safety,
technical expertise, and responsible care of the environment and of our community.

[Find out more about Hawkins through our company videos][43]

[Hawkins-Locations Map-2025]

**Locations**

Having fast access to the equipment, support and the service you need for your operation is
important. That’s why Hawkins has been expanding. Check back often to see if we’ve opened a location
near you!

[Find Locations Near You][44]

***Hawkins Has Been Serving Customers For Over 85 Years.  ***

***We Have A Dedicated Team Ready To Help You With All Your Chemical, Ingredient, And Service
Needs.***

Industries with robust R&D Division at Tarapur, Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation

  Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals and also produces Formulations with its wholly-owned subsidiary

### What We Do


ADNOC L&S is a fully integrated global energy maritime logistics leader that operates onshore and
offshore energy-related logistics activities, including international energy transportation, for
more than 100 customers in over 50 countries with offices in 19 cities. 

With a total fleet of 340+ owned vessels and an additional 600+ chartered every year, a talent base
of over 11,500 people and a steadfast commitment to decarbonization and technological innovation,
ADNOC L&S offers secure, dependable, and efficient maritime and logistics solutions across the
entire energy value chain.

## ADNOC L&S Business Units

### Integrated Logistics

The Integrated Logistics business segment provides comprehensive offshore logistics solutions,
including the transportation of people, materials, equipment, fuel and water. The business segment
also provides diving support, support base and shoreside support services, and materials handling
and storage.

[Explore][38]

### Shipping

The Shipping business segment offers commercial shipping solutions for the transportation of energy
and related products such as crude oil, refined products, Liquefied Natural Gas and Liquefied
Petroleum Gas.

[Explore][39]

### Services

The Services business segment delivers marine and onshore services including terminal operations,
warehousing and onshore materials handling, maritime traffic management, petroleum ports operations,
oil spill and HNS response, commercial pools management, ship management and bunkering.

[Explore][40]

#### Captain Abdulkareem Al Masabi

“As a global energy maritime logistics leader, ADNOC L&S provides world-class Integrated Logistics,
Shipping and Services capabilities to more than 100 customers in over 50 countries.  Through our
transformational growth strategy, we are building a business of scale that unlocks new value for
customers, shareholders, and the UAE through efficient and diversified operations, a commitment to
technological innovation, a 100% HSE culture and a sustainability journey that contributes to the
UAE's ambition to achieve net-zero emissions by 2050 and progress towards the IMO 2050 requirements
for shipping to hit net-zero.”

[Leadership][41]

## ESG

At ADNOC L&S, ESG is a core operational and strategic priority. As a leading provider of maritime
logistics and services, we maintain a deeply rooted connection to the nation’s rich seafaring
maritime heritage and sustainability is deeply held within the DNA of our company. We are fully
aligned with the International Maritime Organization strategy for greenhouse gas emissions and are
making major contributions to ADNOC Group’s 2045 Net Zero target and the UAE’s Net Zero 2050
strategy. Since 2023, we have committed $6.25 billion toward LNG carriers and dual-fuel vessels,
driving significant improvements in fleet energy efficiency and supporting our emissions reduction
goals and reduced the carbon intensity of our shipping operations by 56% since 2019.

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

[⟶][114]
[

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

[⟶][116]
[

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs. 

[⟶][118]
[

### Our CDMO Services

][119]

We offer fully integrated **CDMO services **covering the entire process: from initial planning and
supply chain management to regulatory affairs, for your drug product.

[⟶][120]

## Our Network

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

## Our Network

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying

focus on their core competencies.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

⟶][127]

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

[⟶][114]
[

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs. 

[⟶][118]

### Our CDMO Services

][119]

supply chain management to regulatory affairs, for your drug product.

## Our Network

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

# Affygility Solutions

## EHS for Life Sciences

Since 2002, Affygility Solutions has been providing potent compound safety, occupational toxicology
and industrial hygiene services to biotechnology, pharmaceutical and medical device companies
throughout the world.

**OEL Fastrac** is a convenient and affordable way for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device
and other life science companies to obtain high-quality occupational exposure limit (OEL) and
permitted daily exposure (PDE) monographs.

[Learn more about OEL Fastrac][1]

**OEL Fastrac+** is a cutting-edge digital subscription-based solution designed to swiftly provide
previews of OEL/ADE values in an HBEL database. This innovative platform promises to improve
toxicology team efficiency, elevate standards, and minimize risks. Certified toxicologists and
quality assurance professionals with decades of industry experience prepare each report.

[Learn more about OEL Fastrac+][2]

### [Services][3]

We provide a broad range of environmental, health and safety consulting services to the life science
industry, including [Potent Compound Safety Categorization][4], [Toxicology Services][5], and
[more][6].

[View all our services][7]

### [Training][8]

We provide affordable [online training][9] and [high-quality recorded seminars][10] for EHS
professionals in the life sciences. Additionally, we can provide customized on-site training
throughout the world.

[View our training courses][11]

### [Insights][12]

We explore informative and timely topics covering potent compound safety for the life sciences, with
industry experts and thought leaders [dropping some serious knowledge][13].

[Gain some Insights][14]

**Affytrac** is our secure EHS software for the life science industry, currently in use at dozens of
biotechnology, pharmaceutical and medical device companies.

[Learn more about Affytrac][15]

**Potent Compound Corner** is our collection of musings, investigations and explorations of timely,
relevant topics in the fields of toxicology, pharmacology, EHS and more.

[Explore the Potent Compound Corner][16]

**Virtual Risk Assessment** (VRA) utilizes video conferencing tools in risk assessments for
laboratories, pilot plants, manufacturing plants, and packaging and labeling facilities. The core
process of the review remains the same regardless if it is conducted in-person or virtually, but
conducting a review virtually can save time and money.

[Learn more about Virtual Risk Assesment][17]

We've provided these services to small, mid-size and large companies throughout the United States,
Canada, Europe and Asia. Our services provide **rapid results** and are **high-quality**.

To discuss how we can help your organization achieve high performance EHS results, call us at
303-884-3028 or [contact us online][18].

We deliver affordable and quality medicines across the world, regardless of geographic and

[Click here to][22] Download Our Brochure!

### Our Mission

We strive for a happier, healthier tomorrow. We shall be working on total customer satisfaction and
achieve leadership in pharmaceutical marketplace, products and services across the globe, through
excellence in technology, based on research and development , compliance with regulatory
requirements and expectation in an effective and efficient manner. Our human resources will continue
to be the most valuable asset in this pursuit of leadership and the prime driving forces for our
growth. We are responsible to society. We shall be good corporate citizens and will be driven by
high ethical standardizing our practices.

### Our Vision

Our vision is to be leading pharmaceutical company in India and become a significant global player.
Our aim is to be a global player, will lead to the establishment of operation in the key markets of
the world including the developing countries. We apply to enrich our people – our driving force, to
become highly competent professional and technology based.

* **Arab Health**
* **IPHEX**
* **CPHI India**
Why Choose Us

Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. is a young & emerging global pharmaceutical manufacturing &
marketing company. We manufacture & market a broad range of Pharmaceutical finished formulations.

In the year 2000, Mr. Jitendra Prasad, a young Engineering graduate having pharmaceutical project
background, had established Akriti Export Agencies. In very short span of time he had given a
profitable shape of business to Akriti Export Agencies because of his hard work and very positive
mental attitude. Our activities range from manufacturing & marketing of finished pharmaceutical
formulations of Niche therapeutic segments. Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. has its headquarter in
Thane suburb of Mumbai, the financial capital of India .

Akriti Pharmaceuticals has operation in ** CIS Countries** and now expanding its wings to
**European, South East Asian, Latin American, Middle East & African countries**.

Our manufacturing unit has been approved with various International certifications and follows the
laid down norms of FDA India, CGMP under Schedule 'M' as well as it is **WHO-GMP **certified.

Welcome To Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd.

We deliver affordable and quality medicines across the world, regardless of geographic and
socio-economic barriers. This aptitude of ours can be credited to our successful portfolio of
businesses.

Through our efficient manufacturing services backed with highly qualified technical team, we
endeavor to build blocks to produce an organization that manufactures therapeutics for a variety of
diseases.

[Click here to][22] Download Our Brochure!

### Our Mission

We strive for a happier, healthier tomorrow. We shall be working on total customer satisfaction and
achieve leadership in pharmaceutical marketplace, products and services across the globe, through
excellence in technology, based on research and development , compliance with regulatory
requirements and expectation in an effective and efficient manner. Our human resources will continue
to be the most valuable asset in this pursuit of leadership and the prime driving forces for our
growth. We are responsible to society. We shall be good corporate citizens and will be driven by
high ethical standardizing our practices.

### Our Vision

Our vision is to be leading pharmaceutical company in India and become a significant global player.
Our aim is to be a global player, will lead to the establishment of operation in the key markets of
the world including the developing countries. We apply to enrich our people – our driving force, to
become highly competent professional and technology based.

Why Choose Us

Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. is a young & emerging global pharmaceutical manufacturing &
marketing company. We manufacture & market a broad range of Pharmaceutical finished formulations.

In the year 2000, Mr. Jitendra Prasad, a young Engineering graduate having pharmaceutical project
background, had established Akriti Export Agencies. In very short span of time he had given a
profitable shape of business to Akriti Export Agencies because of his hard work and very positive
mental attitude. Our activities range from manufacturing & marketing of finished pharmaceutical
formulations of Niche therapeutic segments. Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. has its headquarter in
Thane suburb of Mumbai, the financial capital of India .

Akriti Pharmaceuticals has operation in ** CIS Countries** and now expanding its wings to
**European, South East Asian, Latin American, Middle East & African countries**.

Our manufacturing unit has been approved with various International certifications and follows the
laid down norms of FDA India, CGMP under Schedule 'M' as well as it is **WHO-GMP **certified.

## Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd.: Leading the Way in Pharma Manufacturing

▼

Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. stands as India’s largest and most trusted Contract Development
and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), redefining pharmaceutical excellence through innovation,
quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development
of superior formulations while enhancing supply chain reliability for our partners.

Quality at Akums is more than a benchmark—it is a culture. We adhere to global regulatory standards,
including WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, and TGA, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and
efficacy standards. Our advanced Quality Management System (QMS) and compliance-driven approach
reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Akums collaborates with 1500+ pharmaceutical companies, manufacturing over 4100+ commercialized
formulations. Our expertise extends beyond manufacturing to include formulation development,
technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their
portfolios and market presence seamlessly.

While innovation fuels our growth, sustainability shapes our future. Akums integrates eco-friendly
initiatives and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, ensuring responsible business operations
that contribute to a healthier planet.

Leading the Make in India initiative, Akums continues to revolutionize global healthcare by
providing high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical solutions with a patient-first approach,
strengthening its position as a driving force in the industry.

## Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd.: Leading the Way in Pharma Manufacturing

▼

Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. stands as India’s largest and most trusted Contract Development
and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), redefining pharmaceutical excellence through innovation,
quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development
of superior formulations while enhancing supply chain reliability for our partners.

Quality at Akums is more than a benchmark—it is a culture. We adhere to global regulatory standards,
including WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, and TGA, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and
efficacy standards. Our advanced Quality Management System (QMS) and compliance-driven approach
reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Akums collaborates with 1500+ pharmaceutical companies, manufacturing over 4100+ commercialized
formulations. Our expertise extends beyond manufacturing to include formulation development,
technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their
portfolios and market presence seamlessly.

While innovation fuels our growth, sustainability shapes our future. Akums integrates eco-friendly
initiatives and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, ensuring responsible business operations
that contribute to a healthier planet.

Leading the Make in India initiative, Akums continues to revolutionize global healthcare by
providing high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical solutions with a patient-first approach,
strengthening its position as a driving force in the industry.

Began production of Cephalosporin C

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2013

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

#### A Day in the Life of a Veterinary Scientist, Ophthalmology

Marianna Bacellar-Galdino has always loved scientific research, and after a particularly eye-opening
project in veterinary school, ophthalmology became the thread connecting all her scientific
interests—and eventually her whole career.

[Watch now! ][19]

We are a forward-thinking, mid-size early phase contract research organization, in Canada and the
U.S., offering biopharmaceutical companies of all sizes a proven, flexible approach to early drug
development, including preclinical safety testing, clinical pharmacology (Phase I to Phase II),
bioanalysis (preclinical to Phase IV), research services, and manufacturing and analytical services.

Focused on your success … always available and always looking ahead ... moving in unison to deliver
big impact with a personal touch.

## WHAT WE DO

We help you reach early phase drug development decision-making milestones sooner, improving speed
and ease from lead candidate selection to proof of concept, and beyond.

[READ MORE][88]

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

## Follow us and keep up to date

[2021 annual report][95]

the site. If you have already subscribed you can also log-in through the link.

## Share price

We transform the lives of people affected by rare, debilitating conditions by providing innovative
medicines that bring hope to those in greatest need.

# Ending drug shortages with advanced biosynthesis

[Image of a flower]

### Nature is our most powerful source of medicine

While nature has provided the foundation for modern medicine, it wasn’t designed to meet the scale
and demand of 21st century healthcare needs. Today’s pharmaceutical supply chains are largely
reliant on fragile agricultural sources with low predictability, resulting in drug shortages that
ultimately impact patient care.

## Nature is our most powerful source of medicine

While nature has provided the foundation for modern medicine, it wasn’t designed to meet the scale
and demand of 21st century healthcare needs.

Today’s pharmaceutical supply chains are largely reliant on fragile agricultural sources with low
predictability, resulting in drug shortages that ultimately impact patient care.

## We manufacture essential medicines

Antheia’s biosynthesis platform leverages advanced manufacturing technologies to produce
biosynthetic Key Starting Materials (KSMs) and Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) for
essential medicines in a more efficient, agile, and sustainable approach. Advanced biosynthesis will
transform pharmaceutical supply chains and unlock new opportunities in drug development and
discovery.

[ See Our Pipeline ][24]

### A revolutionary alternative to legacy approaches

The USDA cites that 40% of Western drugs are derived from plants. These medicines are sourced in an
agricultural process that is typically inefficient, inflexible, and highly susceptible to climate
events, inconsistent soil health, pests, and diseases. We need a more efficient, sustainable, and
reliable approach than legacy agricultural-based sources.

### Supply Chain

Agricultural sources can have unpredictable yields. Manufacturing in contained fermentation
environments offers a more reliable, controlled, and consistent supply.

### Resource Utilization

Agricultural-based manufacturing is inefficient and expensive. Purpose-built biomanufacturing
facilities reduce the need for agricultural sourcing and the associated costs, environmental
impacts, and long timelines.

### Novel Solution

Chemical synthesis is not suitable for KSMs and APIs of greater complexity. Advanced biosynthesis –
the leading 21st century technology – enables efficient biomanufacturing of pharma ingredients of
unprecedented complexity.

### Setting a new standard for pharma manufacturing

## Adam Takos, PhD

## Head of Drug Innovation and Managing Director, Singapore

Adam has spent two decades driven by a fascination with how we can harness biology to solve complex
challenges. His journey has been a rewarding evolution—from making fundamental discoveries in plant
specialized metabolism to leading industrial programs in metabolic engineering and drug discovery.
Beyond the technical work, Adam is an advocate for “no-fear-of-failure” team cultures. Having worked
across three countries, he values the diverse perspectives that drive innovation and help us turn
ambitious research into practical, life-saving solutions.

## Chris Savile, PhD

## Head of Business Development and Partnerships

Chris has spent the past 20 years focused on the development and commercialization of
biomanufacturing processes across multiple sectors and has spent his recent career focused on
identifying high-value commercial opportunities and building strategic partnerships in pharma, food,
and health and wellness. Prior to joining Antheia, he was CEO at Willow Biosciences, executive
director, commercial operations at Intrexon, and associate director, business development and senior
scientist, R&D at Codexis. Chris holds a PhD in organic chemistry from McGill University.

## Dr. Stefan Bauer

## Head of Analytical Development

Stefan is a senior biotechnology leader in analytical chemistry and a passionate scientific and
technical expert in analytical methods and principles, especially chromatography and mass
spectrometry, using an extensive range of instrumentations for a variety of analytes in complex
matrices, such as microbial fermentations. With a 20-year career-long commitment to high quality
standards, focusing on optimizing and simplifying workflows, he excels at developing high-throughput
methods that drive efficiency, cost savings, operational excellence, and scientific innovation.
Previously, he led the bioanalytical teams at UC Berkeley, Zymergen, Perfect Day, Novonutrients,
Inscripta, and Manus.

## Andrew Saarni

## Head of Fermentation Process Development & Scale-Up

Andrew is a strategic bioprocess leader with over a decade of experience guiding fermentation
process development and scale-up efforts from early-stage R&D through commercial deployment for
small molecules, proteins, and now, vital alkaloid medicines. He has a proven track record of
aligning technical execution with business strategy, driving technology transfer and manufacturing
readiness at domestic and international CDMOs, and building fermentation infrastructures that

## We manufacture essential medicines

Antheia’s biosynthesis platform leverages advanced manufacturing technologies to produce
biosynthetic Key Starting Materials (KSMs) and Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) for
essential medicines in a more efficient, agile, and sustainable approach. Advanced biosynthesis will
transform pharmaceutical supply chains and unlock new opportunities in drug development and
discovery.

[ See Our Pipeline ][26]

### A revolutionary alternative to legacy approaches

The USDA cites that 40% of Western drugs are derived from plants. These medicines are sourced in an
agricultural process that is typically inefficient, inflexible, and highly susceptible to climate
events, inconsistent soil health, pests, and diseases. We need a more efficient, sustainable, and
reliable approach than legacy agricultural-based sources.

### Supply chain

Agricultural sources can have unpredictable yields. Manufacturing in contained fermentation
environments offers a more reliable, controlled, and consistent supply.

### Resource utilization

Agricultural-based manufacturing is inefficient and expensive. Purpose-built biomanufacturing
facilities reduce the need for agricultural sourcing and the associated costs, environmental
impacts, and long timelines.

### Novel solution

Chemical synthesis is not suitable for KSMs and APIs of greater complexity. Advanced biosynthesis –
the leading 21st century technology – enables efficient biomanufacturing of pharma ingredients of
unprecedented complexity.

biomanufacturing processes across multiple sectors and has spent his recent career focused on

methods that drive efficiency, cost savings, operational excellence, and scientific innovation.

## Understanding
## Your Cerilliant® Certificate of Analysis

#### Comprehensive Details

COAs are data-inclusive, with full transparency for end-user application including traceability and
uncertainty determinations.

#### Consistency

Lot-to-lot consistency, stability, and retest data ensure reliable results over time.

#### Stability

Expiry/retest dates, shipping, and storage conditions supported by accelerated and real-time
stability data.

#### Stringent Analytical Characterization

Inorganic impurities, often excluded from certified concentrations, can impact purity, stability,
and accuracy.

Purity and identity are verified using two orthogonal methods with detailed data on residual
solvents, water, and trace inorganics provided to ensure accuracy and lot-to-lot consistency.

## Products

Cerilliant® Certified Reference Materials (CRMs) include native and stable-isotope labeled parent,
metabolites, and related compounds for clinical, forensic, pharmaceutical, nutraceutical,
environmental and other testing and research applications.
Illicit Drug, Pharmaceutical, & Alcohol Standards
Stimulants, depressants, opioids, hallucinogens, cannabinoids, inhalants, synthetic drugs, and
others for toxicological testing applications.
Biomarker & Metabolite
Standards
Hormones, hydroxyvitamin D, amino acid metabolites, catecholamines, and other endogenous biomarkers.
Vitamins & Other
Natural Products
Water- and fat-soluble vitamin, phytochemicals, protein, peptide, and lipid standards for various
chromatography & mass spectrometry testing applications.

Cerilliant® Certified Reference Materials

# Empowered by Legacy, Driven by Accuracy

Power your results with Cerilliant® high-quality certified reference materials, expertly crafted for
forensic, clinical, pharmaceutical, nutraceutical and environmental testing and research.

[ New Products ][55] [ Product Catalog ][56]
ISO 9001:2015
ISO/IEC 17025:2017
ISO 17034:2016

## Accuracy Matters

Since 1980, Cerilliant® Certified Reference Materials (CRMs) have set the standard for trust and
excellence, combining industry-leading **quality** and comprehensive selection with data-inclusive
certificates of analysis (COAs). Empowered by our **legacy** of high **quality** and
**reliability**, we are driven by **accuracy** and **innovation** to ensure your confidence and
success at every step. Results are only as accurate as your reference!
Cerilliant® Legacy
Cerilliant® Innovation
45+

#### Years of Excellence and Experience

150+

#### Passionate and Curious Scientists & Support Staff

33%

#### Staff with 10+ years of Cerilliant® Service

2300+

#### CRMs to Drive Accuracy for Your Analytical Results

## Your Benefits

Simplify your analytical process with trusted standards, accredited quality, and data-driven
performance — all backed by Cerilliant’s proven expertise and commitment to accuracy.
[Student Life]
**Convenient Snap-N-Shoot® & Certified Spiking Solutions®**
**ISO/IEC 17025, ISO 17034 Accredited**
**Data-Driven Expiry and Storage Requirements**
**Comprehensive Certificates of Analysis (COAs)**
**Custom Standard Services**

## Understanding
## Your Cerilliant® Certificate of Analysis

#### Comprehensive Details

COAs are data-inclusive, with full transparency for end-user application including traceability and
uncertainty determinations.

#### Consistency

Lot-to-lot consistency, stability, and retest data ensure reliable results over time.

#### Stability

Expiry/retest dates, shipping, and storage conditions supported by accelerated and real-time
stability data.

#### Stringent Analytical Characterization

Inorganic impurities, often excluded from certified concentrations, can impact purity, stability,
and accuracy.

Purity and identity are verified using two orthogonal methods with detailed data on residual
solvents, water, and trace inorganics provided to ensure accuracy and lot-to-lot consistency.

## Products

Cerilliant® Certified Reference Materials (CRMs) include native and stable-isotope labeled parent,
metabolites, and related compounds for clinical, forensic, pharmaceutical, nutraceutical,
environmental and other testing and research applications.
Illicit Drug, Pharmaceutical, & Alcohol Standards
Stimulants, depressants, opioids, hallucinogens, cannabinoids, inhalants, synthetic drugs, and
others for toxicological testing applications.
Biomarker & Metabolite
Standards
Hormones, hydroxyvitamin D, amino acid metabolites, catecholamines, and other endogenous biomarkers.
Vitamins & Other
Natural Products
Water- and fat-soluble vitamin, phytochemicals, protein, peptide, and lipid standards for various
chromatography & mass spectrometry testing applications.

# RELIABLE
* INGREDIENTS
* DISTRIBUTION
* INNOVATION
* PEOPLE
* DELIVERY
* WAREHOUSING
* SERVICE
* SINCE 1885

Impeccable distribution of high-quality ingredients to the feed, food, pharma and technical
industries worldwide since 1885.

With roots dating back to 1885, Chr. Olesen has grown from a local Danish grocery store into an
international, family-owned business built on quality, reliability and long-term partnerships.

## FEED

The manufacturers constantly refine the ingredients. The producers constantly refine the products.
We pay respect to both by constantly refining the distribution.

Premium quality vitamins, minerals and proteins.
Developed by handpicked manufacturers.
And carefully distributed to the food industry.

### FOOD

### PHARMA

Distributing pharmaceutical ingredients requires specialized knowledge.  But it also requires
something as simple as being reliable.

Polymers, xantam gum and manganese carbonate. We distribute technical ingredients to the technical
industries.

### TECHNICAL INDUSTRIES

## A WORD IS A WORD.

### NO MATTER THE LANGUAGE.

Partnerships are crucial to us. And many of them have existed for generations.
* ### 140 years and we're just getting started
  
  2025 marked our 140^{th }anniversary. That’s worth celebrating. We’ve grown from a small grocery
  and goods store to a global firm with about 200 employees and 5^{th} generation family ownership.
  But the journey has only just started, as we will continue growing our family-run company – just
  as each generation has done before.
  [altText]

## RELIABLE

### SINCE 1885

We are not the same company today as we were when Mads Chr. Olesen founded his small grocery and
goods store back in 1885. But one thing is unchanged – being reliable in everything we do

[Explore our history][42]

### ALWAYS ON TIME.

#### Regardless of TIME ZONE.

Being on time. Every time. This is still as important to the 5^{th} generation as it was to the
founder.

## Reliable development
## Reliable distribution
## Reliable innovation
## Reliable through 5 generations

## CONTACT

Reach out to our industry experts to discuss
how we can work together to grow your business.

## They're slow. They're expensive.

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a

the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

## About the Magazine

Entrepreneur India is a monthly magazine published by Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS),
aimed at simplifying the process of choosing the most suitable project for investment. It makes
business decisions easier and trouble-free by providing a carefully curated list of the right
projects for investment. Unique among project investment magazines, Entrepreneur India is entirely
dedicated to the business of identifying sound investment projects. Every issue consists of a new
list of ventures that are meticulously selected by the NPCS team after rigorous screening on
multiple investment factors — ensuring that each project recommendation is grounded in real market
opportunity and financial viability.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

Paracetamol, being the safest & the most affordable Analgesic & Antipyretic drug, is used for

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

  ### Forward integration for DC

* [icon]
  
  ### 23% Global Market Share in API Paracetamol
* [icon]
  
  ### 40% Domestic India Market Share in Paracetamol API

## Our Pharmaceutical API Products & Formulations

### Paracetamol API – Multiple Grades for Every Formulation

Paracetamol, being the safest & the most affordable Analgesic & Antipyretic drug, is used for
treating fever, flu, body pain and cold.

Our DC provides drum-to-feeder compression/encapsulation solutions that are both economically sound
and operationally simple.

Introducing Our Latest API Range from Units 4 & 5

## boundaries of innovation

## Expanding the
## boundaries of accessibility

[slide_innovation]
[slide_patient]
[slide_globally]

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

By combining our deep scientific expertise with agile commercial strategies, we are uniquely

healthcare professionals, and  healthcare segments worldwide.

## Join Us

At Glenmark, we want talent to build more than a career. We want them to undertake a quest full of
substance and meaning.

Where chasing breakthroughs is part of the everyday and shaping the future of global health the
goal.

Where we live, breathe and deliver innovation while also expanding accessibility to high-quality
products for patients around the world.

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set
up by the Dutch feed industry in 1992 as a certification scheme for feed safety. Today, GMP+
International is a not-for-profit with over 20,000 [GMP+ certified companies][51] in 90 countries.

## The GMP+ Company database


Do you want to find GMP+ certified companies, Certification Bodies, laboratories, or partners? The

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set
up by the Dutch feed industry in 1992 as a certification scheme for feed safety. Today, GMP+
International is a not-for-profit with over 20,000 [GMP+ certified companies][51] in 90 countries. 

[More about GMP+ International ][52]

[Image]

## GMP+ Feed Certification scheme

The GMP+ Feed Certification (GMP+ FC) scheme provides internationally recognised standards to
produce safe feed, and a growing set of international standards for sustainable feed.

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

[Our chain approach]

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

### A growing community


As a GMP+ certified company, you are part of a growing and committed community of over 19,000
companies in 87 countries. GMP+ certified companies enjoy a very solid reputation for being reliable
and committed to feed safety.

### Independent audits


GMP+ certified companies are audited yearly by auditors working for independent Certification
Bodies.

# Your Global Bridge to Critical Medicines

As a trusted pharmaceutical supplier since 2003, GNH India bridges the gap between the world's most
critical medicines and the patients and institutions who need them. From named patient supply and
orphan drug sourcing to clinical trial supply and government pharmaceutical programs — we deliver
with regulatory precision, cold chain integrity, and a commitment to access that goes beyond
borders.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

positioned to serve people regardless of geographies. Our new identity embodies this drive to expand

Our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of life-saving
medicines across the world.

living in the poorest parts of the world.

## Built for businesses that need both filings and strategy

Most businesses in India choose between two kinds of partner. Filing platforms are fast and cheap,
but they will not advise you on a market entry, a transaction, or an audit. Boutique consulting
firms are strong on strategy, but they will not file your GSTR-3B or push your DIR-3 KYC. KAMRIT
does both.

That works because KAMRIT is structured as a financial services LLP with capability across
registration, tax, audit, and corporate compliance, and it operates alongside our sister firm
Claight (same directors, same shareholders) which publishes research, analytics, and procurement
intelligence across nineteen industries. Filings flow into advisory. Advisory flows into filings.
One partner is accountable.

## What that gets you
* **Volume work without the platform cost.** Private Limited Company registration starts at ₹4,899.
  GST returns from ₹699 a month. Trademark filing at ₹4,899. All fixed fee.
* **Strategic work without the Big-Four price.** India entry, feasibility studies, GTM strategy,
  M&A, and transfer pricing engagements led by senior partners.
* **Research at your shoulder.** Claight market intelligence informs our India entry and GTM work,
  used by clients across SaaS, manufacturing, healthcare, and consumer goods.
* **A single calendar across regulators.** ROC, FEMA, RBI, GST, Income Tax, PF, ESI, Shops Act, all
  owned, filed, and reported on monthly.

Frequently asked

## Quick answers from our experts.

What services does KAMRIT offer?

KAMRIT offers the complete India advisory stack. Company registration (Private Limited, LLP, OPC,
Section 8, Producer, Nidhi), GST registration and returns, income tax and TDS, MCA and ROC
compliance, trademark and IP, payroll and labour, audit and assurance, plus India entry, GTM
strategy, M&A advisory, and FEMA / RBI work.

How is KAMRIT different from IndiaFilings or a typical CA firm?

Two ways. First, we run both the filings (like a platform) and the strategic advisory (like a
consulting firm) under one roof, so a Private Limited Company registration can flow into a GTM
strategy and an audited annual return without changing vendors. Second, KAMRIT and our sister firm
Claight share directors and shareholders, which means our India entry, market sizing, and
procurement intelligence work sits on top of the same research feeds Fortune 500 strategy and
procurement teams already use.

How much does company registration cost in India?

KAMRIT registers a Private Limited Company starting at ₹4,899, an LLP starting at ₹3,899, a One
Person Company at ₹3,899, and a Sole Proprietorship at ₹1,899. Pricing is fixed-fee and inclusive of
MCA name approval, MOA and AOA drafting, incorporation, PAN, TAN, and bank account opening
assistance.

How long does GST registration take?

A standard GST registration takes seven to ten working days from document submission, subject to the
GSTN officer's processing time. KAMRIT files within one business day of receiving complete documents
and tracks every notification end to end.

submission.

notification.

industry domain.

## Built for businesses that need both filings and strategy

Most businesses in India choose between two kinds of partner. Filing platforms are fast and cheap,
but they will not advise you on a market entry, a transaction, or an audit. Boutique consulting
firms are strong on strategy, but they will not file your GSTR-3B or push your DIR-3 KYC. KAMRIT
does both.

That works because KAMRIT is structured as a financial services LLP with capability across
registration, tax, audit, and corporate compliance, and it operates alongside our sister firm
Claight (same directors, same shareholders) which publishes research, analytics, and procurement
intelligence across nineteen industries. Filings flow into advisory. Advisory flows into filings.
One partner is accountable.

* **Volume work without the platform cost.** Private Limited Company registration starts at ₹4,899.

* **Strategic work without the Big-Four price.** India entry, feasibility studies, GTM strategy,
  M&A, and transfer pricing engagements led by senior partners.
* **Research at your shoulder.** Claight market intelligence informs our India entry and GTM work,
  used by clients across SaaS, manufacturing, healthcare, and consumer goods.
* **A single calendar across regulators.** ROC, FEMA, RBI, GST, Income Tax, PF, ESI, Shops Act, all
  owned, filed, and reported on monthly.

## Quick answers from our experts.

What services does KAMRIT offer?

KAMRIT offers the complete India advisory stack. Company registration (Private Limited, LLP, OPC,
Section 8, Producer, Nidhi), GST registration and returns, income tax and TDS, MCA and ROC
compliance, trademark and IP, payroll and labour, audit and assurance, plus India entry, GTM
strategy, M&A advisory, and FEMA / RBI work.

How is KAMRIT different from IndiaFilings or a typical CA firm?

Two ways. First, we run both the filings (like a platform) and the strategic advisory (like a
consulting firm) under one roof, so a Private Limited Company registration can flow into a GTM
strategy and an audited annual return without changing vendors. Second, KAMRIT and our sister firm
Claight share directors and shareholders, which means our India entry, market sizing, and
procurement intelligence work sits on top of the same research feeds Fortune 500 strategy and
procurement teams already use.

How much does company registration cost in India?

KAMRIT registers a Private Limited Company starting at ₹4,899, an LLP starting at ₹3,899, a One
Person Company at ₹3,899, and a Sole Proprietorship at ₹1,899. Pricing is fixed-fee and inclusive of
MCA name approval, MOA and AOA drafting, incorporation, PAN, TAN, and bank account opening
assistance.

How long does GST registration take?

A standard GST registration takes seven to ten working days from document submission, subject to the
GSTN officer's processing time. KAMRIT files within one business day of receiving complete documents
and tracks every notification end to end.
